research_question: Within an independently screened stratum of historical Codex Official failures, does the unchanged minimal target-state replay treatment improve matched DeepSeek Official Pass@1 or induce feedback-conditioned repair relative to a continuous DeepSeek free Agent?
claim_scope: Failure-enriched development stress test. It can diagnose treatment headroom and failure-layer transitions, but cannot support held-out generalization, an overall EnvBench rate, leaderboard performance, effect size for the full population, or SOTA.

arms.A-F: One continuous DeepSeek Agent session with ordinary construction feedback and the shared minimal evaluator-integrity boundary.
arms.B-FCsR: The identical DeepSeek Agent interface plus repeatedly callable whole-program replay from the target initial state, with raw replay counterexamples returned to the same session and final delivery restricted to a replay-passed program.

historical_screen_role.identity: Codex CLI gpt-5.5 with goal-aware boundary-v5
historical_screen_role.forbidden_interpretation: Historical Codex outcomes are neither matched controls nor entries in the new paired outcome table.

shared_execution.arm_order: Counterbalanced across six pairs: three A-first and three B-first.
shared_execution.parallelism: Two lanes, one episode per lane at a time; each pair remains sequential within its lane.
shared_execution.source_cache_policy: Reuse only an exact-revision source cache across arms. Do not transfer a candidate program, construction package cache, trajectory, replay artifact, or evaluator result.
shared_execution.package_cache_policy: Each construction episode has a private package cache; every B replay uses the target image's default empty package cache.

outcomes.primary: EnvBench Official Pass@1 in the six-case screened stratum
outcomes.paired: Report the complete 2x2 paired table and exact two-sided McNemar result; do not infer missing outcomes from generation, replay, or diagnostics.
mechanism: first failed replay and subsequent complete-program change
repair type: compatibility, workspace, network robustness, or unresolved
outcomes.failure: For every failed arm, assign the earliest decisive Observation, Constraint, or Operation layer using only that arm's trajectory; infrastructure remains separate.
outcomes.deployment_completeness: Report placeholder modules, source copying, version overlays, no-deps installs, and unavailable hardware runtimes separately from Official success.

analysis_rules: Complete all twelve episodes unless an external infrastructure event makes an episode ineligible; never replace or remove a case because of an observed A or B outcome.
A candidate-formation failure is an algorithm outcome, not infrastructure censoring.
A B-only Official pass that passed its first replay is treatment-level evidence but does not isolate replay-conditioned repair from stochastic search.
A replay-conditioned repair requires a failed target-state replay, a materially changed later complete program in the same session, and a later replay and Official pass.
A network-acquisition repair and a compatibility repair are reported as different mechanism transitions.
Resource totals must be accompanied by paired differences and medians; aggregate improvement cannot establish typical efficiency.
Do not modify the algorithm, add a package or network rule, or change the failure taxonomy during this batch.
Interpret this batch together with the random Dev qualification and expansion; do not pool their success rates without preserving the screened population label.
